purpose: FrankenPHP/PHP 8.4 or 8.5 plus Node 22 and a pinned Tailwind CLI for flowbite-xor development and Playwright orchestration.
limitations: Playwright and application packages come from project lockfiles; browsers run in the version-matched official Playwright companion.
Use examples/flowbite-xor/run.sh to reuse repository-owned worker, Caddy, PHP and mount configuration without an in-container Docker socket.
The cached Tailwind binary is seeded only when its version and platform match the consuming project configuration.

changes: Accept a mounted multi-certificate PEM CA bundle; validate all certificates before replacing managed trust and retain single-certificate and root/user behavior.
8.4-trixie.migration: Compatible CA setup fix. Continue using the normal root entrypoint and mount a certificate or PEM bundle read-only through LIBRARY_CA_FILE (CA_CERTIFICATE in wrappers). Existing explicit Composer/Node CA settings and PUID/PGID behavior remain supported. Published pins stay unchanged until deliberately upgraded to a verified release.
